result:
Build passes.

## Summary

Added the service-date capture UI to the Deadlines tab in `frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.jsx`:

- `frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.jsx:9` — imported the existing axios `api` client (unmodified) for the PUT call.
- `frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.jsx:194-202` — `DeadlinesView` now receives `documentId`/`sessionId` from `ResultsPage`.
- `frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.jsx:296-318` — `DeadlinesView` renders the new `ServiceDateForm` above the deadline cards (form stays visible regardless of whether deadlines exist yet).
- `frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.jsx:320-410` — new `ServiceDateForm` component:
  - Date input + method select (personal/substitute/posted/unknown, defaulting to `unknown`).
  - Second date input for `clerk_mailing_date` appears only when method is `posted`.
  - Submits via `api.put('/api/deadline/{documentId}/service-date', body, {params: {session_id}})` — uses the existing client as-is, no edits to `api.js`.
  - On `recompute: "complete"`, shows "If you were served on X, your response is due Y" using `deadlines[0].due_date`.
  - On `recompute: "escalated"`, shows the `guidance` text, no deadline.
  - On 422, surfaces `err.response.data.detail` inline.
  - Form values persist in state after submit — remain visible/editable and re-submittable.

`npm run build` passes (`vite build` completed, only a pre-existing chunk-size warning, no errors).

Not touched: the "I don't know" path and recompute-on-edit refresh flows (A-2, out of scope), and `src/api.js` itself (left as-is per the collision-map constraint).
